title: My first concert
instructions: Ben ilk konserini anlatıyor. Yaşını, kiminle gittiğini ve neler olduğunu takip et.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: I went to my first concert when I was fifteen.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: It was my favourite rock band, and I went with my older sister.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: We waited outside for three hours to get near the stage.

script.speaker: ben
script.text: When the band came on, everyone screamed. It was so loud that I couldn't hear my sister!

script.speaker: ben
script.text: I bought a black T-shirt with the band's name on it. I still have it today.

questions.prompt: How old was Ben at his first concert?
questions.feedback: İlk konserine on beş yaşında gitti.
